name: Cá song
summary: Cá song is the fish you pick by the kilogram on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, sometimes split above and below 2 kg. Cá song vang, cá song hoa, and cá song vang lai hổ are separate orders.
howToEat: Pick it by weight and have the kitchen cook it. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
